verdict.rationale: Throttling or queuing executions is a fair question for a workflow automation platform, but the evidence pack never documents concurrency limits, rate limiting, or execution queue controls. The only reliability item, durable execution resuming from a checkpoint, is about recovering interrupted runs, not about respecting downstream rate limits, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can throttle or queue workflow executions to respect downstream rate limits
